# laravelforge_credential (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge server credential by ID within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the credential.
- `organization` (String) Slug of the Forge organization that owns the credential.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_provider` (String) Provider the credential authenticates against, e.g. `Hetzner Cloud` (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `in_use` (Boolean) Whether the credential is currently in use by a server.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
